notes.title: #InfiniPrison
notes.content:
#InfiniPrison is now released! It's a time-attack stage that's added at the end of the fourth tombstone. You can share your highscore on social media with #InfiniPrison.
Our net revenue from your purchase of this DLC will be donated to the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR). This is an initiative that was proposed by our publisher, Nakana, so you can get more details on their website: nakana.io

notes.title: Infini's original sountrack is out NOW and on discount until March 27th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Infini's soundtrack is now out. You can get it on discount until March 27th. You can also get a bundle of the game + soundtrack on discount. 

You can listen to an excerpt of the soundtrack here : https://soundcloud.com/roche-ovale/sets/infini

Also, if you've played the game and enjoyed it, please leave a review on the store page, that would mean a lot to us!

Thanks!

notes.title: Infini release date announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're really excited to announce that Infini will be releasing on Steam on March 4 2020.
Along with this announcement is a demo of the game, [i]Glimpse of Infini[/i] that is now available for download.

We've also released a new trailer!
